welcome.subject: Welcome to rejira
welcome.heading: Welcome to rejira, {name}
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Sign in to start tracking issues with your team.
welcome.footer: rejira — a Jira replacement for engineering teams

verify_email.subject: Verify your email for rejira
verify_email.heading: Verify your email
verify_email.body: Hi {name}, click the button below to verify your email address.
verify_email.footer: If you didn't create this account, you can ignore this email.

reset_password.subject: Reset your rejira password
reset_password.heading: Reset your password
reset_password.body: Hi {name}, click the button below to reset your password.
reset_password.footer: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your rejira password was changed
password_changed.heading: Password changed
password_changed.body: Hi {name}, your password was successfully changed. If this was you, no further action is needed.
password_changed.footer: If you did not change your password, please contact support immediately.

magic_link.subject: Sign in to rejira
magic_link.heading: Sign in to rejira
magic_link.body: Hi {name}, click the button below to sign in instantly.
magic_link.expires: This link expires in 15 minutes and can only be used once.
magic_link.footer: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

new_device.subject: New sign-in to rejira
new_device.heading: New sign-in to rejira
new_device.body: Hi {name}, a new sign-in was detected from an unrecognized device.
new_device.not_you: If this was you, you can ignore this email. If not, change your password immediately.

workspace_invite.subject: You've been invited to join {workspace}
workspace_invite.heading: You've been invited to join {workspace}
workspace_invite.body: You've been invited to join {workspace} on rejira as a {role}.
workspace_invite.expires: This invitation expires in 7 days. If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore it.

role_changed.subject: Your role in {workspace} has changed
role_changed.heading: Your role has changed
role_changed.body: Your role in {workspace} has been changed to {role} by {actor}.
role_changed.footer: If you believe this was a mistake, contact your workspace owner.
